title: Simple Changes remote branch open proposal targets
description: Sidecar beside the loop lease for one remote-branch reconciliation receipt: every open proposal the final inventory saw, from any source project, and the branch it targets. `loop finalize` reads it so a branch an open proposal targets is reported as held, never as pending cleanup. Kept out of the lease so older clients can still read the lease; when it is absent, finalization treats the targets as unknown.
